Greek.reason: Greek refers to the language used in the evidence bundle (financial news in English, Chinese, Japanese, Spanish, and Greek) and is tokenized as a script; therefore it is studied.

Japanese.reason: Japanese refers to the language used in the evidence bundle and is tokenized as Japanese kana; therefore it is studied.

Latin.reason: Latin refers to the Latin script ranges in the tokenization regex, not the Latin language; therefore it is a false_positive.

Arabic.reason: Arabic refers to Arabic-script characters in the tokenization regex, not the Arabic language; therefore it is a false_positive.

Chinese.reason: Chinese refers to the language used in the evidence bundle (financial news in Chinese) and is tokenized as CJK characters; therefore it is studied.

Spanish.reason: Spanish refers to the language used in the evidence bundle (financial news in Spanish) and is tokenized as a script; therefore it is studied.

English.reason: English refers to the language of the questions and evidence and is used throughout the dataset; therefore it is studied.
